master-safety-chain-trace.title: Master Safety Chain Trace, CR407 Not Energized

yes.result: Master safety relay is made. If equipment will not run, troubleshoot downstream interlock outputs.

m2.question: Is 120 VAC present on Wire 4071 feeding CR407?

yes.result: CR407 coil/socket/relay fault. Voltage is present but relay is not energizing.

m3.question: Is CR4191 closed and passing voltage?

no.result: E-Stop branch open. Check PB4191, PB4192, PB4193, CR419 coil, and CR4191 contact.

m4.question: Is CR4171 closed and passing voltage?

no.result: Reset branch open. Check PB4181 safety reset, TD4161 power fail timer, and CR417 relay.

m5.question: Is CR4371 closed and passing voltage?

no.result: NH3 shutdown branch open. Check CR437 and Wire 437 from RC-7 Relay 5.

m6.question: Is CR5061 closed and passing voltage?

no.result: HTR1 high level branch open. Check FS5011, CR5011, TD5041, and CR5061.

m7.question: Is CR5131 closed and passing voltage?

yes.result: Primary upstream safety contacts appear made. Check wiring into CR407 coil and relay base.

no.result: LTR1 high level branch open. Check FS5081, CR5081, TD5111, and CR5131.

h1.question: Is HTR1 actually in high level?

yes.result: Real high level condition. Correct vessel level before reset.

h2.question: Is FS5011 in normal state and passing voltage?

CR5011 coil/path fault. Verify voltage from FS5011 path.

h4.question: Is TD5041 input/output made after delay?

no.result: TD5041 timer or timer contact fault.

h5.question: Is CR5061 energized and contact passing to CR407 chain?

yes.result: HTR1 high level circuit appears healthy.

no.result: CR5061 relay/contact fault or missing timer output.

evis-mua-shutdown-integrated.title: Evis M/U Air Shutdown Integrated Trace

e1.question: Is Wire 609 active from NH3 monitoring?

no.result: NH3 system is not commanding Evis MUA shutdown. Check normal RC-6 Evis MUA interlocks.

e2.question: Is CR6091 responding to Wire 609 command?

no.result: CR6091 coil/socket/wiring fault or command not reaching relay.

e3.question: Are Evis MUA Unit 1, 2, and 3 interlocks closed?

yes.result: Evis MUA shutdown chain appears healthy. Check external fan starters/control.

no.result: One Evis MUA unit interlock is open. Check starter, overload, disconnect, and aux contact.
